LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANTS REGENTS OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA, SCOT MERRICK, JASLEEN KUKREJA, GINA INTINARELLI'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT. THE COURT TREATS THE MOTION AS A MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION BY THE REGENTS AS TO THE NON-FRAUD CLAIMS. AS SUCH THE MOTION IS GRANTED. DEFENDANT HAS PRESENTED UNREBUTTED EVIDENCE THAT PLAINTIFF'S INJURY WAS NOT CAUSED BY DEFENDANT'S NEGLIGENCE. PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST FOR A CONTINUANCE IS DENIED BECAUSE PLAINTIFF'S DECLARATION DOES NOT INDICATE WHAT FACTS IT REASONABLY EXPECTS TO OBTAIN OR HOW SUCH FACTS COULD REASONBLY DEFEAT SUMMARY JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF HAS NO EXCUSABLE REASON NOT TO HAVE SOUGHT DISCOVERY BEFORE ITS OPPOSITION WAS DUE, AND PLAINTIFF IS NOT ENTITLED TO A CONTINUANCE SIMPLY TO PURSUE AN OPEN ENDED DISCOVERY PLAN THAT IT COULD HAVE PURSUED WHEN THE MOTION WAS FILED. PREVAILING PARTY TO SUBMIT FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR 8189.
